tts_instructions: Energetic, upbeat, confident. Punchy and fast-paced, with real enthusiasm. Emphasise key numbers.

vo.en: Most workshops still do this by hand.
It takes four hours, and no two come out the same.
This machine does it in twenty minutes, identically, every time.
Zero point one millimeter repeatability, on all three axes.
No computer needed. Everything runs from the handheld pendant.
See it at acme dot i-o.
